Name: Vanilla Furniture Tweaks
Author: Novamare
Description:
[size=4][b]~ Features ~[/b][/size]
[size=3]This mod aims to retexture some of the vanilla furniture items so they look slightly nicer, while also maintaining a vanilla [/size][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]appearance.
The mod currently only supports vanilla colours, and no other recolours yet.

*This mod may not work if using a recolour, or any other mods that replace furniture.[/size]
[/color]
[size=4][b]~ Future Updates ~[/b][/size]
[size=3]- Recolour options
- Alternate Textures version[/size]

[size=4][b]~ Requirements ~[/b][/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]
[/url]- ﻿[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]- [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI

[/url][size=4][b]~ Installation ~[/b][/size]
[size=3]1. Download the Mod/Required Mods, and extract them
2. Paste it into your \Stardew Valley\mods\ folder﻿﻿﻿
3. Run the game and enjoy
[/size]
[size=4][b]~ Config Options ~[/b][/size]
[size=3]"Enable mod" (true/false)[/size]


*If there are any issues please let me know and I'll make sure to fix them! :D

[size=4]If you would like to see more content from myself, feel free to support me on [/size][size=4][url=https://ko-fi.com/novamare40991]Ko-fi[/url] <3[/size]﻿﻿

Thank you and I hope you enjoy!
